verdict.rationale: The evidence implies citation-ready metadata but never shows it directly. Exa documents answers with citations (exa-gh-8) and agent output with built-in web citations (exa-docs-26). It also filters on published date via startPublishedDate, which implies date metadata exists (exa-gh-9), and its contents features operate on returned URLs (exa-docs-35). None of the evidence explicitly lists the url, title, and publishedDate fields on each search result, and nothing addresses whether URLs are canonical. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-result url/title/publishedDate fields, any canonical-URL guarantee or normalization, and hands-on corroboration of metadata accuracy.
